verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API documents pairing multiple Solo readers to an account and naming each reader, and Virtual Solo is available to test pairing. That covers device registration and a minimal form of configuration over the API. The evidence does not show a fleet-management surface beyond this. missing for 10: API endpoints for monitoring reader status or health, remote configuration or settings updates beyond naming, fleet-wide listing and management of terminals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely

citations.quote: Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
Naming each Solo card reader as desired to streamline checkout
Virtual Solo simulates a Solo card reader so you can test pairing and checkout flows.
